d.workspace_id=$2 AND d.harness=$3 AND d.session_id IN($4,$5) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM marker)=(SELECT count(*) FROM captured) ORDER BY (d.session_id=$4) DESC LIMIT 1 FOR sessions.session_directory_relationships (org_id, workspace_id, harness, parent_session_id, relationship_uid, child_session_id) SELECT e.org_id, e.workspace_id, e.harness, e.session_id, e.uid, e.child
